WHY RIYADH TRUSTS QSC

Luxury car care built on clarity

Owning a luxury car in Riyadh means facing two recurring questions: who genuinely understands this car, and who will tell me the truth about its condition? QSC Automotive was built to answer both. At the maintenance workshop, everything starts with diagnosis — reading the car's systems and physically verifying every finding before any recommendation. At the Fast Painting workshop, everything starts with assessment — damage photos get a professional read and realistic options before the car moves anywhere.

The result is a way of working owners feel on every visit: a written scope before work, prices that follow assessment rather than precede it, and documentation that protects your car's history and value. With 16 luxury marques supported and 26 specialist services across the two facilities, your car — from a daily-driven Mercedes to a weekend Ferrari — finds the team that knows it.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Which cars does QSC Automotive service?

QSC specializes in luxury and performance vehicles — Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Land Rover, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Ferrari, Lamborghini and other premium marques. See the Car Brands section for how each brand is approached; QSC is an independent specialist, not a dealership.

Where are the QSC workshops located?

QSC operates two dedicated facilities in Riyadh: a maintenance workshop for mechanical, electrical and diagnostic work, and a separate painting & bodywork workshop (Fast Painting) for paint, dent and collision repair. Each has its own page under Our Workshops with location and contact details.

How do I book an appointment?

Three ways: call us, send a WhatsApp message, or use the booking form on this site. Describe the issue or service you need and your car's make and model — the right workshop's team confirms the appointment with you directly.

Do I get a price before the work starts?

Yes. Every job begins with an assessment, after which you receive the finding and the proposed scope for approval. Work only proceeds on what you approve — no surprise invoices.

Can QSC handle both mechanical work and bodywork on the same car?

Yes — that is exactly what the two-workshop model is for. The team coordinates between the maintenance and painting facilities when a vehicle needs both, and you deal with one QSC throughout.
